- For pilots under $25k we can approve up to 20% off list at SE/AE discretion. Anything >$25k needs manager approval.
- If Finance (Dana) is the approver, ask for PO cadence and whether they require a one-time PO or standing PO for pilots.

I’ll be on standby to approve the discount if Marissa confirms the numbers. If this moves to an enterprise commitment, loop in Solutions Eng.
